recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-25230 unless Pharmacy makes a new decision to change patientCharacteristic cardinality or semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-25230 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy request for R5 asking to fix MedicationKnowledge AdministrationGuideline.patientCharacteristic so it could represent a characteristic name/value pair.
initial_application: Git commit 48438a7205421769bebb35c255e22d24aaa57251 applied the request in the old MedicationKnowledge spreadsheet by replacing patientCharacteristic.characteristic[x] plus repeatable value with patientCharacteristic.type and patientCharacteristic.value[x]. The model was later migrated into structuredefinition-MedicationKnowledge.xml.
additional_context: MedicationKnowledge is active in fhir.ini. Later R5 changes renamed the original AdministrationGuideline location to MedicationKnowledge.indicationGuideline.dosingGuideline.patientCharacteristic. FHIR-30089 explicitly retained patientCharacteristic.value[x] at 0..1 while adding Quantity and Range and interpretive guidance, so the current optional value is a later accepted shape rather than an incomplete FHIR-25230 application.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active StructureDefinition already defines patientCharacteristic 0..*, type 1..1 CodeableConcept, and value[x] 0..1 with CodeableConcept, Quantity, and Range choices, and no stale patientCharacteristic.characteristic[x] path remains under source/.
